hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/protected-paths.mjs" ]; then exec node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/protected-paths.mjs"; fi; d="$PWD"; while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do if [ -f "$d/.claude/hooks/protected-paths.mjs" ]; then exec node "$d/.claude/hooks/protected-paths.mjs"; fi; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; exit 0'
